{"sample_id":"arvo_31491","fine_trace":[{"step":1,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_prefix","line":475,"var":"*tags","code":"*tags = ++line;","role":"source","note":"An IRCv3 message beginning with '@' makes the input-controlled tag bytes after '@' the tags string used by the real parser."},{"step":2,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_prefix","line":480,"var":"*line","code":"*line++ = '\\0';","role":"intermediate","note":"The first space after the tag list terminates the input-controlled tags substring, leaving the tag value as a standalone backslash before the NUL terminator."},{"step":3,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_message_tags","line":436,"var":"kv[1]","code":"kv = g_strsplit(*tmp, \"=\", 2);","role":"intermediate","note":"Splitting the tag entry at '=' produces an input-controlled value string kv[1] containing only the lone escape backslash."},{"step":4,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"unescape_tag","line":397,"var":"tmp","code":"tmp++;","role":"root_cause","note":"When tmp points at a trailing backslash, incrementing it advances to the string terminator; the parser should stop if the escaped character is NUL."},{"step":5,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"unescape_tag","line":395,"var":"*tmp","code":"for (; *tmp != '\\0'; tmp++, tag++) {","role":"sink","note":"After the loop update advances tmp past the terminator for the lone escape, the next loop condition reads one byte beyond the tag value string."}],"vuln_logic":{"source":{"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_prefix","line":475,"operands":["*tags","line"]},"root_cause":{"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"unescape_tag","line":397,"operands":["*tmp","'\\0'"],"relation":{"op":"ne","left":"*tmp","right":"'\\0'"}},"sink":{"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"unescape_tag","line":395,"operands":["tmp","tag + strlen(tag)"],"relation":{"op":"le","left":"tmp","right":"tag + strlen(tag)"}},"propagation":[{"from":{"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_prefix","line":475,"operands":["*tags"]},"to":{"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_prefix","line":480,"operands":["*line"]},"type":"data","via":["line"],"relation":{"op":"eq","left":"*line","right":"' '"}},{"from":{"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_prefix","line":480,"operands":["*tags"]},"to":{"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_message_tags","line":436,"operands":["kv[1]"]},"type":"data","via":["tags","*tmp","g_strsplit(*tmp, \"=\", 2)"]},{"from":{"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_message_tags","line":436,"operands":["kv[1]"]},"to":{"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"unescape_tag","line":397,"operands":["tmp"]},"type":"data","via":["unescape_tag(kv[1])","tag","tmp"]},{"from":{"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"unescape_tag","line":397,"operands":["tmp"]},"to":{"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"unescape_tag","line":395,"operands":["*tmp"]},"type":"order","via":["tmp++","tag++"]}]}}
